name: Carrera Latido Rosa 2026
notes: Evening 4K and 8K run. Registration is $275 per distance.
sourceNotes: Time/venue/prices from Chronostart's own registration page. tritour.org and running.life list the same date. running.life puts it in San Bernardino Tlaxcalancingo; city left as Puebla per tritour.
notesEs: Carrera nocturna de 4K y 8K. La inscripción cuesta $275 por distancia.

name: Social Run Adidas Puebla 2026
notes: Non-competitive social run, 7K at your own pace, limited to 1,000 runners. Waves start 7:00, 7:05 and 7:10 by pace. From $400.
sourceNotes: Event page has no /inscripcion link rendered, so signupUrl left null. Page header shows a generic '13:00 h' that conflicts with the 7:00 am schedule in the body; body schedule used. Organizer from contact email (keeprunning).
notesEs: Social run no competitivo de 7K a tu propio ritmo, cupo de 1,000 corredores. Salidas a las 7:00, 7:05 y 7:10 según ritmo. Desde $400.

name: Carrera de las Iglesias 2026
notes: Afternoon run with 3K, 5K and 10K options. Registration is $275 per distance.
sourceNotes: Chronostart page gives venue 'San Francisco Acatepec'. running.life labels it San Luis Tehuiloyocan; both are in San Andrés Cholula municipality (tritour: San Andrés Cholula).
notesEs: Carrera vespertina con opciones de 3K, 5K y 10K. La inscripción cuesta $275 por distancia.

name: Social Run Sportico Puebla 2026
notes: Non-competitive social run with 3K and 7K options, limited to 1,000 runners, in support of CRIT Teletón Puebla. Waves start 7:00, 7:05 and 7:10. From $350.
sourceNotes: Asdeporte page header shows generic '13:00 h'; body says 07:00 am, body used. Also on running.life.
notesEs: Social run no competitivo con opciones de 3K y 7K, cupo de 1,000 corredores, a favor del CRIT Teletón Puebla. Salidas a las 7:00, 7:05 y 7:10. Desde $350.

name: Reto Vulcano 2026
notes: Trail race at the foot of Pico de Orizaba with 14K, 30K and 40K options plus free kids' races. Online sales have closed and the main distances are sold out.
sourceNotes: carrerasmexico page rendered: 7 Nov 2026, salida 07:00, prices 750/1050/1400, venta cerrada 19-Oct. running.life adds a 6K 'Los Gentiles' and start at Hacienda Sandoval / finish at auditorio municipal; 6K not on the registration page so omitted. signupUrl null because online sale is closed.
notesEs: Carrera de trail al pie del Pico de Orizaba con 14K, 30K y 40K, más carreras infantiles gratuitas. La venta en línea cerró y las distancias principales están agotadas.

name: 4a Carrera Trozmer 2026
notes: 5K and 10K run at Angelópolis. Registration is $330 per distance.
sourceNotes: Chronostart own page; tritour and running.life agree on date.
notesEs: Carrera de 5K y 10K en Angelópolis. La inscripción cuesta $330 por distancia.

name: Mistercarrera Atlixco 2026 (Edición 25)
notes: 15K and 6K run starting and finishing at the Atlixco zócalo, with cash prizes in the 15K. From $395.
sourceNotes: Asdeporte page header shows generic '13:00 h'; body says 7:00 am, body used. Organizer inferred from contact email domain (mtsport).
notesEs: Carrera de 15K y 6K con salida y meta en el zócalo de Atlixco, con premios en efectivo en los 15K. Desde $395.

name: Travesía de las Tres Culturas 2026
notes: Two-stage mountain race, 60 km total with 2,550 m of climbing, camping between stages. Runs 13 to 15 November.
sourceNotes: Official site says '2da edición 13 al 15 de noviembre, 2026'; stage day/date of the first stage taken as 13 Nov. Registration link not extractable from the page, signupUrl null. No price/start time published on fetched page.
notesEs: Carrera de montaña por etapas, 60 km en total con 2,550 m de desnivel positivo y campamento entre etapas. Del 13 al 15 de noviembre.

name: Borregos Think Feel Run Puebla 2026
notes: 3K, 5K and 10K run at Tec de Monterrey Campus Puebla, plus kids' 400 m and 800 m races. Registration is $400 (kids $200).
sourceNotes: Chronostart own page. running.life places it in San Bernardino Tlaxcalancingo; city kept as Puebla per tritour.
notesEs: Carrera de 3K, 5K y 10K en el Tec de Monterrey Campus Puebla, más carreras infantiles de 400 m y 800 m. La inscripción cuesta $400 (infantil $200).

name: 3a Carrera Pericos
notes: 3K, 5K and 10K run at the Hermanos Serdán baseball stadium. Registration is $418.
sourceNotes: Existing row has 2026-12-06 (tritour.org; a search snippet also said 6 Dec). Chronostart's own registration page and running.life both say 13 Dec 2026 at 07:00; Chronostart is the timing company so 13 Dec used. Organizer inferred from venue/name. Conflict unresolved with tritour.
notesEs: Carrera de 3K, 5K y 10K en el Estadio de Béisbol Hermanos Serdán. La inscripción cuesta $418.

name: The Santa Run Puebla 2026
venue: Parque del Arte, Reserva Territorial Atlixcáyotl
notes: Recreational Christmas-themed run with 1K, 5K and 10K and a post-race holiday experience; every runner gets a raffle entry. From $490.
sourceNotes: Page header shows generic '13:00 h'; body says arranque 7:00 am, body used.
notesEs: Carrera recreativa navideña de 1K, 5K y 10K con experiencia navideña al final; cada corredor participa en una rifa. Desde $490.

name: 13.ª Carrera AMANC Puebla 2027
venue: Parque de la Niñez, Blvd. del Niño Poblano
notes: Charity run for children and teens with cancer: 3K, 5K and 10K. From $300.
sourceNotes: Asdeporte page; header '13:00 h' generic, body says arranque 7:00 am. Venue address is San Bernardino Tlaxcalancingo (San Andrés Cholula municipality).
notesEs: Carrera a beneficio de niñas, niños y adolescentes con cáncer: 3K, 5K y 10K. Desde $300.

name: Superman & Supergirl Run Puebla 2027
notes: 5K and 10K run (plus a 3K walk) at Parque Sendela, next to Angelópolis. Top three finishers per rama are awarded. From $840.
sourceNotes: Asdeporte page; header '13:00 h' generic, body says from 7:00 a.m. Organizer not named on page.
notesEs: Carrera de 5K y 10K (más caminata de 3K) en el Parque Sendela, junto a Angelópolis. Se premia a los tres primeros de cada rama. Desde $840.

name: Desafío en las Nubes 2027
notes: Trail running weekend in Xicotepec with distances from 2.5K to 48K. The 48K requires proof of mountain-race experience.
sourceNotes: Only source is running.life (19-20 Feb 2027); its description says 19 to 21 Feb. Dates unverified on organizer page; welcu registration link not loaded. Start date used = 19 Feb.
notesEs: Fin de semana de trail en Xicotepec con distancias de 2.5K a 48K. Para los 48K se requiere acreditar experiencia en carreras de montaña.

name: Niebla Trail 2027 (5ª edición)
notes: Trail race during the Feria de las Flores with 7K, 13K and 23K options.
sourceNotes: Only source is running.life. Boletopolis event 40869 is JS-rendered (empty shell), so signupUrl left null.
notesEs: Carrera de trail durante la Feria de las Flores con opciones de 7K, 13K y 23K.
